title: Strategic And Critical Minerals
definition: Strategic and critical minerals are non-fuel metallic or non-metallic minerals that are essential for the economic development and national security of a country, the supply chain of which is vulnerable to disruption.
importanceInUpsc: Highly relevant for GS Paper 3 (Economy - Industry, Infrastructure, Security, Environment) and Prelims (Geography, Economy, Science & Technology), focusing on India's net-zero transition, supply chain resilience, and Atmanirbhar Bharat.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Strategic And Critical Minerals.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian mineral sector
Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) - MMDR Act basics
